criteria.long_description: Tasks 2-4: GNS3 API by curl, Python/gns3fy project build, and Ansible verbosity/debugging.

ratings.long_description: Drives the GNS3 API directly with curl, builds and modifies a project with the Python/gns3fy scripts, and runs playbooks read at increasing verbosity.

criteria.description: Build, configure, and fix the network
criteria.long_description: Tasks 5-7: construct and start the topology, configure all devices, repair the DHCP Jinja template.

ratings.long_description: Builds and starts the topology with the make/start playbooks, configures every device, repairs the vyos-dhcp Jinja template, and proves the IPv4 lab path exits through VyOS-1 rather than the management NAT.

criteria.long_description: Task 8: extend the automation to dual-stack the routers.

ratings.long_description: Extends the Ansible variables and templates to dual-stack the routers and proves IPv6 connectivity from VyOS-1.

criteria.long_description: Task 9: complete IPv6 reachability across the network.

ratings.long_description: Completes IPv6 reachability across the whole network by static routes, applied through Ansible and proven end to end.

criteria.long_description: Task 10: automate SLAAC on the client-facing interfaces.

ratings.long_description: Automates SLAAC on the two client interfaces and shows a client autoconfiguring an IPv6 address.
Meets the Lab Report Guidelines: fixed-width command output, only the requested evidence, and proper citations.

criteria.long_description: Task 9 Option B: OSPFv3 configured with Ansible. Bonus, above the 75-point base.

ratings.long_description: Bonus: OSPFv3 configured with Ansible and IPv6 reachability proven through it.
